description: S59 T6 (EV15): environment.unbind removes a COMPONENT binding and answers whether anything was removed — `unbound:false` is the honest answer for a scope that held nothing, distinct from an error, because "nothing was bound" is a fact a panel must be able to print. A WORKSPACE binding cannot be unbound through this door at all: the system floor is replaced by binding another environment, never by removing the floor.
